name: BlitzGS
definition: A distributed 3DGS framework that reduces active Gaussian workload at three coupled levels: system-level sharding by index parity, model-level population control via importance scoring and spawn gating, and view-level filtering via distance-based LOD and importance masks.
summary: BlitzGS is a distributed 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that accelerates city-scale training by sharding Gaussians by index parity and applying importance-based pruning and LOD filtering.
